extracted.name: Lox Bagel
extracted.description: This delicious Lox Bagel recipe only takes 5 minutes to make, with your favorite bagel, herb cream cheese, smoked salmon, red onions, capers, and fresh dill.
ingredient_lines: 2/3 cup herb and chive flavor cream cheese (, or plain)
10 oz cold smoked salmon or lox slices
Small chunk of red onion (, thinly sliced)
Other optional toppings: thinly sliced cucumber, tomato, avocado
instruction_lines: Cut open bagels and spread each half generously with cream cheese.
Add thin slices of smoked salmon on top. Top with a few slices of red onion, capers and a sprinkle of fresh dill. You could also make it into a lox bagel sandwich.
